Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory with detailed data on building ages, sizes, classrooms, specialized spaces, and site acreage (Appendix B). Robust condition assessments include HVAC, plumbing, roofs, electrical, lighting, technology infrastructure, and accessibility features. Connections made between facility conditions and educational outcomes, with integration into capital planning (Sections D and F).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Detailed long-term enrollment projections by grade and site with methodology and assumptions explained (Appendix C). Capacity utilization data by site and grade with state and district loading standards provided (Appendix B). Enrollment projections linked to facility needs and development impact analysis with explicit strategies for boundary reviews and facility adjustments (Sections C, E, and G).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational goals and mission are clearly integrated into the facilities master plan (Section A). Detailed educational specifications including flexible classrooms, technology integration, specialized program spaces (CTE, special education, STEM labs) are described (Section B). Facility projects and upgrades are directly connected to educational programs and instructional needs (Sections D and G).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Site maps and acreage data provided for all schools (Appendix B). Some references to playgrounds, shade structures, and landscaping improvements are included (Sections D and F). Strategies for greening and outdoor learning are mentioned but not fully districtwide or detailed; no comprehensive districtwide data on green space or climate-adapted design.

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: The plan acknowledges climate-related facility impacts and includes some strategies such as energy efficiency upgrades and solar power installations (Sections B and F). However, it lacks a comprehensive climate risk assessment or detailed mitigation strategies across multiple climate impacts and sites.

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Energy efficiency and resilience are core components of the plan with detailed data on energy use and costs by site (Sections D and F). The plan references Title 24 compliance, electrification, solar power installations, and energy management system upgrades. Strategies include HVAC upgrades, LED lighting, solar arrays, and microgrids to improve resilience and reduce emissions.

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Comprehensive financial plan with detailed cost estimates for modernization and new construction, including escalation and contingencies (Section F). Clear prioritization of projects by SFID and educational needs. Multiple funding sources outlined including bonds, developer fees, state funds, and sale of surplus property. The plan aligns financial capacity with district priorities and includes long-term sustainability considerations.
